newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Vengold lifts stake in Lihir.
newsitem.headline: Vengold lifts stake in Lihir.

text.p: Vengold Inc said on Wednesday it has agreed to buy 7.8 million shares in Lihir Gold Ltd for C$19.38 million, increasing its stake in the Papua New Guinea gold miner to 8.4 percent from 7.5 percent.
Vengold said the acquisition would be funded by a prospectus offering of 9.45 million shares at C$2.05 a share.
It said the transactions were expected to close on or before June 16 and would result in Vengold having 85 million shares outstanding.

Lihir said on May 26 it had commenced production of gold dore following the commissioning of the ore processing and production facilities at its gold mine on the Papua New Guinea island of Lihir and that commissioning of the sulphide processing facilities remained on schedule for August 1997.
Lihir said anticipated ore output from the mine in May was about 150,000 tonnes.
Lihir forecasts gold production of 175,000 ounces in calendar 1997, and over 600,000 a year when in full production.
Other shareholders in Lihir Gold include Niugini Mining Ltd with 17.15 percent and Orogen Minerals Ltd with eight percent.
